from test_workflow_commands import WorkflowCommandTests  # noqa

class Probe(WorkflowCommandTests):
    def test_probe_frozen_hash_lies_after_frozen_edit(self) -> None:
        script = self.write_workflow(
            'meta = {"name": "probe"}\nreturn "orig"'
        )
        launch = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "run", str(script)])
        self.assertEqual(launch.returncode, 0, launch.stderr)
        p = json.loads(launch.stdout)
        wf_id = p["wfId"]
        self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "wait", wf_id, "--timeout", "10"])
        frozen = Path(p["scriptPath"])
        frozen.write_text('meta = {"name": "probe"}\nreturn "EDITED-FROZEN"\n', encoding="utf-8")
        actual = hashlib.sha256(frozen.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        resumed = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "run", "--resume", wf_id])
        rp = json.loads(resumed.stdout)
        print("PROBE scriptPath   :", rp["scriptPath"])
        print("PROBE printed sha  :", rp.get("scriptSha256"))
        print("PROBE actual frozen:", actual)
        print("PROBE warnings     :", rp.get("warnings"))
        self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "wait", wf_id, "--timeout", "10"])
        res = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "result", wf_id])
        print("PROBE result       :", json.loads(res.stdout)["result"])
        print("PROBE MATCH        :", rp.get("scriptSha256") == actual)


def load_tests(loader, tests, pattern):
    s = unittest.TestSuite()
    s.addTest(Probe("test_probe_frozen_hash_lies_after_frozen_edit"))
    return s
